_source: Maui Nui Landscape Conservation Plan (DOFAW, version September 29, 2026), Literature Cited, pp. 115-119 (MNLCP 9-30-2026 FINAL.txt lines 4576-4755). 49 entries in plan order; PDF line breaks, page numbers and form feeds removed; wording, punctuation and orthography otherwise unchanged. 'year' is a string (four-digit year, 'in prep.', or 'n.d.'). 'url' is given only where the plan prints a DOI or URL; no URLs were added. Appendix 2 has its own short References list (lines 5781-5810); all five of its works also appear here.
